verdict.rationale: Lambda's Cloud API and docs confirm programmatic launch and termination of instances, with per-minute billing while an instance runs (docs-5, docs-23, docs-31, docs-10), and community evidence confirms an unofficial CLI/MCP wrapper for launching/terminating instances (lambda-labs-comm-3). However, docs never describe a distinct 'stop/pause' or 'restart' instance state (only launch/terminate), and a hands-on report shows billing continues for any running instance regardless of idle use, undermining the 'pay only for what is running' nuance (lambda-labs-comm-1). missing for 10: documented stop/restart API states distinct from terminate, and independent confirmation that idle-but-stopped instances incur no charge.
